unmögliche, fantastische oder märchenhafte Geschichten erfinden und erzählen

examples.text: Auch Zeitungen „fabelten“ – so Bismarck – von einem Panzerhemd.

Plötzlich gab es lauter Experten, die geläufig von sinus cavernosus und arteria carotis interna zu fabeln verstanden, sich Aufschluß versprachen von einem HirnSzintigramm, einer Trepanation des Schädels …
„Seid ihr nicht wahnsinnig, Götter zu ehren, von denen man euch fabelt, während vom Himmel begünstigtere Wesen mitten unter euch weilen? …“
Der Pöbel aber, welcher des Entsetzens nie genug hat, fabelte noch überdem von ganzen Ladungen unheilbarer Kranker, die, um mit ihnen zu räumen, nachts in den Strom geschüttet würden.
Wenn ihr vielleicht vorbehalten war, jenen Schatz zu heben, von dessen Wert und Größe die Sage Unglaubliches fabelte?…

translations.source_sense_description: unmögliche, fantastische oder märchenhafte Geschichten erfinden und erzählen

glosses: To indulge in fantasy; to imagine things only possible in fantasy.

examples.text: I fantasized about my ideal date.

glosses: To portray in the mind, using fantasy.

examples.text: Not that Mom and I didn't have our "shared experiences" — it's just that I'd like to forget most of them. I'd rather fantasize us together in that little cafe.
Actress Dana Delany fantasizes about making love with two men.

translations.source_sense_description: unmögliche, fantastische oder märchenhafte Geschichten erfinden und erzählen

glosses: An intimate relationship between two people; a love affair.

examples.text:
Everybody's working for the weekend
Everybody wants a new romance.

glosses: A strong obsession or attachment for something or someone.
Idealized love which is pure or beautiful.
A story, novel, film, etc., centred around an idealized love relationship.
A story relating to chivalry; a story involving knights, heroes, adventures, quests, etc.

examples.text: `Will you undertake the task? We give you complete freedom, and as a reward you will, we believe, have the credit of presenting to the world the most wonderful history, as distinguished from romance, that its records can show.'

glosses: A tale of high adventure.

examples.text: Could one have known the past histories of some of the oddly-selected couples who shared everything in common, many a romance might have been written during what, to all outward appearances, was a dull and prosaic time to most lookers-on!

glosses: A mysterious, exciting, or fascinating quality.
A literary or filmic genre about idealized love.
An embellished account of something; an idealized lie.
An adventure, or series of extraordinary events, resembling those narrated in romances.

examples.text: His life was a romance.

glosses: A dreamy, imaginative habit of mind; a disposition to ignore what is real.

examples.text: She was so full of romance she would forget what she was supposed to be doing.

glosses: A sentimental piece of music; a romanza.
To woo; to court.

examples.text: A female Shepard can romance bisexual Yeoman Kelly Chambers, but doing so does not yield a Paramour achievement or an implied sex scene the way that romancing ‘official’ interests does. Similarly, the player can attempt to romance the Asari Samara or her Ardat-Yakshi daughter Morinth, but the former will refuse and sex with the latter will kill Shepard.
In the ghetto, the gentle Barber romances a defiant washerwoman, Hannah, who is played by Chaplin's wife at the time, Paulette Goddard.

glosses: To write or tell romantic stories, poetry, letters, etc.
To talk extravagantly and imaginatively; to build castles in the air.

translations.source_sense_description: unmögliche, fantastische oder märchenhafte Geschichten erfinden und erzählen

glosses: Raconter des choses inventées, des fabulations.

examples.text: J’aurais pu les héberger, au moins une nuit, et là j’ai la sensation (mais je fabule sans doute, avec le recul) que ça aurait pu être vraiment sympathique.

glosses: Inventer.

examples.text: Mais je peux (et j’y parviendrai bien, que diable !) fabuler une histoire où il serait question de tout autre chose, mais qui oblige la police à procéder à des vérifications, à ouvrir une enquête où je serai utile comme témoin.
Même fabriqué de toutes pièces, le récit de Fernande aurait le mérite de nous montrer comment la jeune fille fabulait sur son père, ou plutôt contre lui.

Une telle sanction était suffisamment rare pour que les villageois ne pussent plus parler d’autre chose pendant des semaines, s’évertuant à décrire le sifflement de la gifle, fabulant sur les marques des doigts qui seraient restées visibles pendant trois jours, et sur les paupières du malheureux qui plus jamais ne cesseraient de cligner.

examples.text: Собственно, так называемое «общество» представляет слишком мало интересного, чтобы стоило много распространяться об нём. Оно живёт своею обычною, бесцветною жизнью; порою, от нечего делать, фантазирует, порою, тоже от нечего делать, эти же самые фантазии преследует.

examples.text: Он меня выучил читать и писать, он сказывал мне сказки, он помогал мне, играя в игрушки, фантазировать из них целые истории.
